name: Poll
summary: Run a live poll in the channel, one vote per person, and watch the bars fill in.
description: Launch a poll from the apps menu (or type /poll Question? | option a, option b) and vote together. Each person has one vote: tap a bar to vote, tap another to move it. 'close poll' stops further votes and shows the result; 'reset' starts over. The poll and an opaque per-module id for each voter are kept in the message itself; the module stores nothing and learns nothing else about you. Because that state passes through each member's client, this stops accidents and casual padding, not a member who forges it.

changes: Long questions wrap and long options are shortened so nothing runs off the poll.
The close poll button closes the poll.
First release: one vote per person.
